# Cabos Handyman

> Cabos Handyman is the leading professional handyman and home maintenance company in Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur, Mexico. With 20+ years of experience and 600+ completed projects, we serve residential homeowners, vacation rental owners, HOA communities, and commercial properties throughout Los Cabos. Licensed, insured, and bonded. Service calls start at $60 USD. Emergency service available 24/7 for Property Care Plan members.

## Contact & Location

- **Phone:** +52 612 169 8328

- **Location:** Cabo San Lucas, BCS, Mexico (serves all of Los Cabos)
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 7am–6pm, Saturday 8am–2pm

- **Rating:** 4.8 stars across 150+ Google reviews
